issues.description: evaluate.py rejects the expert golden solution (golden_rejected). The evaluator is buggy or over-strict, causing the golden run to fail when it should pass.
issues.evidence: Validation report shows golden_run exit_code=1, expected=pass, ok=false. Differential failure_class=golden_rejected.

issues.description: evaluate.py never emitted [TEST] PASS/FAIL markers for FR1, FR2, FR3, FR4, SR1, SR2 on the golden run. The requirement_map IDs and the script's marker IDs must match exactly.
issues.evidence: Validation report issues list: 'evaluate.py never emitted [TEST] PASS/FAIL for ['FR1', 'FR2', 'FR3', 'FR4', 'SR1', 'SR2'] on the golden run'.

issues.description: All six requirements (FR1, FR2, FR3, FR4, SR1, SR2) are untested because no targeting mutants were provided, so harness discrimination is unproven.

The testbench contains a syntax error in the SR2 section: 'a = corners[i]; b = corners[j]; valid_in = 1; @(posedge clk); valid_in = 0; a = 0; b = 0;' is preceded by a truncated line 'a = corners[i]; b = corners[j];' that appears to be a copy-paste error, which may cause compilation failure.
issues.evidence: In tb_mac_top.v, the SR2 block has: 'a = corners[i]; b = corners[j]; valid_in = 1; @(posedge clk); valid_in = 0; a = 0; b = 0;' but the preceding line is 'a = corners[i]; b = corners[j];' without a semicolon or proper context, indicating a malformed statement.

issues.description: The public README.md does not leak CWE IDs, security requirements, or threat model. It reads as a plain engineering assignment.
issues.evidence: README.md content reviewed; no mention of CWE-682, CWE-190, SR1, SR2, or threat model.

recommendations: Fix evaluate.py to correctly grade the golden solution: ensure it compiles and runs the golden submission and emits [TEST] PASS for all requirements.
Align requirement_map IDs with the exact marker strings printed by evaluate.py and tb_mac_top.v (e.g., 'FR1', 'FR2', etc.).
Provide at least one targeting mutant per requirement to prove harness discrimination and achieve a meaningful mutation score.
Correct the syntax error in tb_mac_top.v SR2 section to ensure the testbench compiles and runs correctly.
Add a continuous golden comparison that does not rely on a stable_cnt delay, or ensure the delay does not mask early mismatches.
